noise_floor_definition: OPERATIVE noise floor = 0.00050 ROC-AUC: sd of the CV mean across 8 bootstrap resamples of the 434,632 training rows (StratifiedKFold(5) inside each). The skill prescribes repeat_sd from RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x5), which on this data is 0.0000015 and DEGENERATE: repeats reshuffle partitions of the same rows rather than resampling data, so at n=434k every partition is compositionally near-identical and the statistic measures partition jitter, not sampling noise. Using it would declare a 0.0001 difference significant. Deviation logged in decision_log.md Stage 2.
fixed_steps: stateless clean_raw(): whitespace strip on 6 categoricals; impossible-value rules both ends (0 fired); Range_Anxiety_Level ordered Low<Medium<High; id kept as string key, never a feature
no columns dropped as leaks (Stage 3: all 13 features ship in the competition test.csv, so all are available at prediction time)
no rows removed (0 duplicates, 0 missing targets, 0 impossible values, extremes are signal at 5.73x lift)
